column1: # The keys of the profile field keys (PROFILE.md «Parameters in keys»). The set is closed; PROFILE.md refers to this form and does not repeat it.
# type: text — a nonempty single-line string; int:<min>..<max> — an integer scalar in the range, an empty <max> has no upper bound; enum:<a>|<b> — exactly one listed word,
# a string scalar, or an integer scalar when every word is a decimal integer. absent: owner — the owning acceptance judges presence, default and applicability;
# not_executed — the checks or targets that need the key are not executed, never PASS. outside: what a value outside the type is: format_error — the profile is refused
# before builds or processes start; not_executed — the target that uses the key is not executed, never PASS.
